title: 第3章 第四天灾倒计时第4章 青木镇之行
lines: 【玩家躯体生成中，预计剩余时间：47小时59分…58分…】
“还有两天……”
姜望喃喃自语，眉头紧锁。
他当然不可能干等。
必须得做点什么。
既要保证自己能活到玩家降临，又要让这个所谓的“游戏世界”
更具可信度。
心念一动，眼前淡蓝色的系统光幕再次浮现。
姜望打开了【游戏管理】的子页面。
也就是之前为了完成任务而仓促搭建的游戏官网。
先是将主页“装修”
了一番。
再是通过【模板商城】花费了10点系统点，解锁了【玩家论坛】功能。
接着，他开始精心编织游戏的“背景故事”
说是背景，实则半真半假。
他将原主姜望的真实经历进行了艺术加工。
其中最重要的一点便是：
【姜望赖以在这场残酷试炼中争锋的独特依仗，便是其身负圣地之力也无法抹去的绝世秘法“界灵引”
，可沟通异界，召唤天外之魂降临……】
编写完毕，确认发布。
官网主页顿时显得有模有样起来，尽管依旧缺少炫酷的原画和视频，但至少有了一个能自圆其说，甚至带点史诗感的框架。
做完这一切，姜望的注意力回到了残酷的现实。
他又检查了一下自己的所有物。
一个最低级的储物袋。
里面装着试炼的标准配置：100枚下品灵石。
对于曾经的仙人而言，自是微不足道。
但在凡人阶段，却已经算是一笔不小的启动资金。
可问题是，身处这大山深处，有灵石也没处花呀。
而且他现在这具身体和普通凡人没什么两样。
之后的玩家也是。
需要食物，需要水。
肚子也已经隐隐有饥饿感传来。
这样下去，别说两天，明天可能就要饿得头晕眼花了。
“必须弄清楚这里是什么地方，最好能找到人烟聚集之处。”
姜望又是想起刚才为自己编造的背景故事。
他的底牌是拥有召唤异世界玩家的能力。
虽然那只是给玩家看的设定。
但这并不意味着他没有别的底牌。
每一名候选者都是上界的天骄翘楚，身上秘密众多，背后或多或少都有家族或势力的馈赠。
姜望闭目凝神，感受着体内那微薄却坚韧的血脉之力。
随即低喝一声：
“太虚神光，启！”
一缕淡金色的光芒自他体内溢出，迅速蔓延全身，将他包裹。
下一刻，便化作一道细微得几乎看不见的金色光线，自废墟中冲天而起，瞬间便掠过了下方茫茫的林海与山峦。
content_en:
[The player body is being generated, estimated remaining time: 47 hours, 59 minutes...58 minutes...]
"Two days left..."
Jiang Wang murmured to himself, frowning.
Of course he couldn't wait.
Something had to be done.
You must not only ensure that you can survive until the player arrives, but also make this so-called "game world"
More credibility.
As soon as I thought about it, the light blue system light screen appeared again in front of me.
Jiang Wang opened the sub-page of [Game Management].
This is the official game website that was hastily built in order to complete the task.
First, "decorate" the homepage
After a while.
Then I spent 10 system points through the [Template Mall] to unlock the [Player Forum] function.
Then, he began to carefully weave the "backstory" of the game
It's said to be background, but it's actually half-truth.
He artistically processed the real experience of the original owner Jiang Wang.
The most important point is:
[Jiang Wang’s unique reliance on competing in this cruel trial is his peerless secret technique "World Spirit Induction" that cannot be erased even with the power of the Holy Land.
, can communicate with other worlds and summon souls from outside the world to come...]
Completed and confirmed for release.
The official homepage suddenly looked more impressive. Although it still lacked cool original paintings and videos, it at least had a framework that could explain itself and even have a sense of epicness.
After doing all this, Jiang Wang's attention returned to the cruel reality.
He checked his belongings again.
A minimal storage bag.
It contains the standard configuration for the trial: 100 low-grade spiritual stones.
For the former immortal, it was insignificant.
But in the mortal stage, it is already a considerable amount of start-up capital.
But the problem is, deep in this mountain, there is no place to spend the spiritual stones.
And his current body is no different from that of an ordinary mortal.
So did the players after that.
Need food, need water.
There was already a faint feeling of hunger in my stomach.
If this continues, let alone two days, I may be so hungry that I feel dizzy tomorrow.
"We have to figure out where this place is, and it's best to find a place where people gather."
Jiang Wang thought again of the background story he had just made up for himself.
His trump card is the ability to summon players from other worlds.
Although that is only a setting for players to see.
But that doesn't mean he doesn't have other cards up his sleeve.
Every candidate is a talented person in the upper world, with many secrets, and more or less gifts from family or power behind them.
Jiang Wang closed his eyes and concentrated, feeling the meager but tough power of blood in his body.
Then he shouted:
"Taixu Divine Light, Kai!"
A ray of light golden light overflowed from his body, quickly spread throughout his body, and enveloped him.
The next moment, it turned into a golden light that was so subtle that it was almost invisible, rising into the sky from the ruins, and instantly passing through the vast forest sea and mountains below.
